name: @hyperlibs/htmxui
author: Hyperlibs Team
description: Hyperreactive lean framework suite for HTMX: zero-eval signals, in-memory columnar search, bank-grade RBAC, kinetic physics & 2D sparse matrix

scripts.build:engines: bun build src/htmx-bolt.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-bolt.js && bun build src/htmx-flash.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-flash.js && bun build src/htmx-form.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-form.js && bun build src/htmx-vibe.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-vibe.js && bun build src/htmx-a11y.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-a11y.js && bun build src/htmx-virtual.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-virtual.js && bun build src/htmx-grid.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-grid.js && bun build src/htmx-offline.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-offline.js && bun build src/htmx-devtools.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-devtools.js && bun build src/htmx-calc.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-calc.js && bun build src/htmx-sim.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-sim.js && bun build src/appz.ts --format iife --outfile public/appz.js && bun build src/htmx-canvas.ts --format iife --outfile public/htmx-canvas.js
scripts.build: bun run build:engines && bun run build:esm && bun run build:css && bun run scripts/build-static.ts
scripts.deploy:pages: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=htmxui
